The list below is {{engine}}’s own catalog, shown for reference; pinning from this panel is disabled because it can only move one axis, and a {{provider}} model id sent to {{engine}} would fail. To change model or engine mid-conversation, use the model switcher in the composer toolbar — it moves both together.
